meta.description: Registry for Phase 2 transition_flux convergence failure modes.

failure_modes.name: transition_flux_divergence
failure_modes.description: Transition flux grows without bound under continuation or iteration.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion
failure_modes.description: Unconstrained candidate generation leads to non-summable transition paths.

failure_modes.name: non_summable_CSI_contribution
failure_modes.description: Causal sphere of influence contributions do not decay sufficiently to ensure finite flux.

failure_modes.name: residue_amplification
failure_modes.description: Positive feedback in residue_update destabilizes continuation selection and flux magnitude.

failure_modes.name: projection_rejection_failure
failure_modes.description: Pi_A fails to adequately suppress inadmissible candidates, leading to unbounded propagation.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_window_collapse
failure_modes.description: Window dynamics result in degenerate states preventing stable flux analysis.

failure_modes.name: infinite_iteration_instability
failure_modes.description: Recursive coupling fails to reach a stable recurrence basin under long-term iteration.
